title: AI-Assisted Auto-formalization for Trustworthy Scientific Computing: Case Studies and Lessons Learned
abstract: arXiv:2611.31033v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic AI tools have recently had success in mathematical reasoning. Both general purpose coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex, and specialized mathematics agents such as Aristotle, have been used for formalizing mathematical problems such as Fermat's last theorem, Erd\H{o}s problems and several IMO level math problems. However, much of these efforts are concentrated in the pure mathematics domain, which benefits from relatively self-contained theorem statements, fixed mathematical representation and extensive support in existing formal libraries. Applied mathematics, on the other hand, presents additional challenges because the source may describe a computational procedure or modeling transformation rather than a declarative theorem. In this work, we present a systematic study of AI-assisted auto-formalization for scientific computing (SC), a domain in applied mathematics central to U.S. Department of Energy applications. Throug

translated_title: 面向可信科学计算的AI辅助自动形式化：案例研究与经验教训
translated_abstract: 智能体AI工具近来在数学推理方面取得了成功。通用编码智能体（如Claude Code和Codex）以及专门的数学智能体（如Aristotle）已被用于形式化诸多数学问题，例如费马大定理、埃尔德什问题以及多个国际数学奥林匹克（IMO）级别的数学问题。然而，这些工作大多集中在纯数学领域，而纯数学得益于相对自包含的定理陈述、固定的数学表示以及现有形式化库的广泛支持。相比之下，应用数学带来了额外的挑战，因为其源材料描述的往往是计算过程或建模变换，而非陈述性定理。在本工作中，我们对科学计算（SC）这一领域的AI辅助自动形式化进行了系统性研究，科学计算是美国能源部核心应用所依赖的应用数学领域。
tldr: 该论文首次对智能体AI在科学计算这一应用数学领域的自动形式化进行了系统性研究，将AI形式化的应用从纯数学拓展到涉及计算过程与建模变换的更复杂场景。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic study of AI-assisted auto-formalization for scientific computing, extending agentic AI's formalization capabilities from pure mathematics to applied mathematics domains involving computational procedures and modeling transformations.
